name: comp-340
title: Accordion Subheader Chevron
blurb: Accordion with subheader text and chevron icon.
description: Main header with a subheader line (smaller text) above content. Chevron rotates on expand.
use_when: Headers with description lines (e.g., 'What is X?' with 'General Category' subtext).
avoid_when: When header text alone is sufficient.
a11y: Subheader included in button text or aria-label for context.
